page.layout: One page of text, single column of verse lines, centred-left; a running head at the top; a catchword "Tu nos" at the lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the margins, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Alma virgo virginum, quæ genuisti Christum, intercede pro nobis.
Christi virgo dilectissima, virtutum operatrix, opē fer miseris. Subveni Domina clamantibus ad te jugiter: Quoniam peccatorum mole premimur, sanctissima, te precamur, subveni.

page.notes: Several words are blurred by the scan, notably "Depoșce" and "hostE", which are doubtful. The first line of the page carries the running head; the "Tu nos" line is the catchword. Right margin has faint show-through and no legible marginal notes. The line "Tu nos" at the foot is treated as a catchword and is also left in the text; verify.
